Fellowship-Trained Surgical Mastery

Precision in Surgery. Excellence in Recovery.

Every procedure is planned with digital precision and biological tissue preservation to ensure minimal pain, anatomical restoration, and rapid return to independent movement.

Gold Standard01

Robotic-Assisted Knee Replacement

Sub-Millimeter Precision

Real-time 3D optical tracking allows dynamic ligament balancing and kinematic alignment, minimizing tissue injury for faster post-operative discharge.

Rapid Recovery Protocol
Rapid Recovery02

Unicondylar (Partial) Knee Replacement

ACL & PCL Preserving

Resurfacing only the damaged compartment while retaining the patient’s natural cruciate ligaments for normal joint proprioception.

Rapid Recovery Protocol
Minimally Invasive03

Arthroscopic ACL & Ligament Reconstruction

Keyhole Athletic Restoration

High-definition endoscopic reconstruction of torn cruciate ligaments using anatomical autografts for high-stability return to sports.

Rapid Recovery Protocol
Tissue Sparing04

Meniscus Repair & Biological Preservation

Joint Cushion Protection

Preserving the natural shock-absorbing meniscus with all-inside suture anchors rather than resection, protecting against long-term arthritis.

Rapid Recovery Protocol
Keyhole Repair05

Shoulder Arthroscopy & Rotator Cuff Repair

Nocturnal Pain Elimination

All-arthroscopic double-row tendon anchoring to bone without separating the overlying deltoid muscle, restoring arm elevation.

Rapid Recovery Protocol
Trauma Care06

Complex Fracture Fixation & Trauma

Rigid Biological Healing

Intramedullary interlocking nailing and anatomical titanium locking plates for accelerated union of complex bone fractures.

Rapid Recovery Protocol

Athletic Excellence & Rehabilitation

Get Back to What Moves You

Whether you are a competitive professional athlete, school player, or passionate weekend runner, Dr. Pradeepta Kumar Maharana brings FIFA-certified sports science to guide your recovery.

FIFA-Certified Evaluation

Standardized assessment of acute ligament sprains, muscle tears, and cartilage trauma adhering to international athletic guidelines.

Return-to-Play Criteria

Objective limb symmetry testing, agility drills, and strength thresholds before clearing an athlete to resume competitive matches.

Injury Prevention & Biomechanics

Neuromuscular conditioning, landing mechanics retraining, and FIFA 11+ warm-up strategies to dramatically reduce re-injury risks.

Sports Nutrition & Conditioning

Comprehensive nutritional counseling to accelerate soft tissue repair, maintain lean muscle mass, and optimize athletic energy.

The Patient Pathway

Committed to Better Mobility & Better Care

From the very first question to your final follow-up, your comfort and active recovery guide every clinical decision.

01

First, We Listen

Your Story & Mobility Goals

We take the time to understand your pain, daily physical demands, and what activities you want to return to doing. We pace the consultation around you.

Phase 01 of Care
02

Then, We Examine

Precise Clinical & Imaging Review

Detailed physical examination of joint stability, gait, and thorough review of your digital X-rays or MRI films with a clear, jargon-free explanation.

Phase 02 of Care
03

Together, We Plan

Transparent Non-Surgical & Surgical Options

We map out treatment choices, recovery timelines, and costs before you decide. Surgery is never the only option; conservative care is prioritized.

Phase 03 of Care
04

Always, We Support

Dedicated Follow-Up & Rehabilitation

From physiotherapy protocols and joint protection exercises to long-term follow-ups, our clinic team stands beside you through your full recovery.

Phase 04 of Care
Preparing For Your Visit

What Should You Bring to the Clinic?

Please carry previous medical reports, prescriptions, physical X-ray films, CT scans, and MRI discs if available. Comfortable loose clothing is recommended for joint examination.
